quote_boxes.en: You're shrine maidens? They sure dress different these days, I suppose this is the Grand Narukami Shrine, after all...
quote_boxes.speaker: Takuma
quote_boxes.t: 당신들 무녀인가요? 요즘은 옷차림이 참 다르군요. 역시 여긴 나루카미 다이샤이겠군요...
